rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Live-demo beats survive a text read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No guess-before-reveal beat anywhere in this file — the exercise is push-back-and-walk-down, not a demo-narration file.

Shortest chunk is 12 "Approve" (lines 99-104, 3 content lines): "Say lock it in. The agent writes the sharpened plan. Approve at the prompt. Then just hit stop." — self-carrying procedural claim, header names the action. No chunk is a bare wait-state or single context-dependent bullet.

chunk 3 "Read the right stuff first": header verb is "Read"; line 37: "Scan for the decisions most likely to change the work: files, design, assumptions, and verification." — the chunk's own body instructs scanning, not reading. This is the same read-vs-scan defect the maintainer block (line 157) records fixing at the sibling chunk 4 header ("Header was Read the plan… until 2026-08-12; Antti caught read-vs-scan — the section instructs scanning, and reading a plan line by line is the move this training argues against") — that fix landed on chunk 4 ("Scan the plan before you push back"), but chunk 3's header, even after today's rename from "Read for the decisions that matter" to "Read the right stuff first," still opens with "Read." Harm: this training's own spine argues against exhaustive reading (M1's countermove, restated one bullet above in the same chunk), so a header instructing "Read" directly over content instructing "Scan" undercuts the point it is teaching — not cosmetic. Carried forward from the prior audited instance (body_sha a1858bc2…), which flagged the identical tension at the header's earlier wording; today's rename did not touch the verb.
rules_evaluated.fix_hint: Retitle chunk 3's header with a scan/select verb (e.g. "Scan the right stuff first"), mirroring the fix already applied to chunk 4.

rules_evaluated.evidence: No "Not X. Not Y. Z." construction anywhere in body. Chunk 4's three consecutive "Notice which…" sentences (lines 41-43) are the only anaphora candidate; each leg carries distinct concrete content (file-naming specificity, verification effectiveness, hidden assumptions) — deliberate scanning checklist, not a tic. No self-grading superlatives ("one of the most useful…" pattern) found in body. No number-with-retraction shape ("Time: 57 minutes", "Eight to twelve", "12 min" are all plain estimates, not a number the sentence then walks back). No abstraction-noun-stack jargon ("the bounded-window reality" style) found. No verb triplet with an empty leg found.

Chunk 5's four bolds (No, keep planning / Soft items / Assumptions / Alternatives) are checklist-item-name handles, maintainer-attested at line 161 ("Handles kept bold"). Chunk 6's law bold ("The agent finds; you judge.") and chunk 14's coined-term bold ("Plan-mode approval inflation") are each single handles at their naming moment. Chunk 0's "stop" is a governor handle. Blockquote callout leads (chunks 6, 7, 8, 10) are chrome, exempt per rule text. No chunk exceeds the effective budget once these carve-outs apply.
